description.value:
You conjure a glowing pack of bacta in an unoccupied or occupied space within range. If a creature you designate occupies that space, it may use its reaction to activate the pack immediately; otherwise, any creature within 5 feet may spend a bonus action to touch and activate it.

Activating the pack restores hit points equal to 1d6 plus your techcasting ability modifier to the activating creature and consumes the pack; droids and constructs are unaffected. If the power ends before the pack is used, it dissolves uselessly.

Cast with a tech slot of 2nd level or higher, you may either add 1d6 to a single pack's healing or create one additional pack in a separate space, for each slot level above 1st.

system.source: PHB Ch.14 Casting — Tech Powers, Level 1
